_real_world.designation: HHQ-9B (naval variant of HQ-9B; also HHQ-9/9A on Type 052C revolver-type VLS)
_real_world.role: Long-range area air defence for the carrier group; anti-aircraft, anti-ASCM, limited anti-ballistic capability claimed
_real_world.range_nmi: ~80-90 nm (ONI 2015 chart-derived estimate, A-derived, best US-official anchor) / >250-300 km land-system HQ-9B figure (B/C, naval equivalence not established)
_real_world.guidance_real: Inertial + command midcourse; track-via-missile/semi-active radar terminal per baseline HQ-9; HQ-9B reportedly adds IR/dual-mode seeker (C-only); active-radar claims also exist but unconfirmed for naval variant
_real_world.speed: Mach 4.2 (HQ-9 baseline, B-tier; HHQ-9B speed not public)
_real_world.cells_per_missile: 1 per universal VLS cell, cold-launched (Xinhua 2021 CCTV footage of 055 bow VLS cold launch)

modeling_notes: Range conflict: ONI 2015 chart-derived ~80-90 nm (A-derived estimate, best US-official anchor) vs land-system HQ-9B figures of >250-300 km (B/C, naval equivalence NOT established) vs export FD-2000B 250 km (C-only, export, not PLAN). Per OOB guidance this record uses the ONI-chart-derived A-derived figure as primary.

A social-media-sourced HHQ-9C quad-pack claim (4 per VLS cell, Sep 2025 parade) is C-only with no A/B confirmation; per OOB explicit instruction, do NOT model 4/cell — this record and the carrying ships' mounts use 1 per universal VLS cell, cold-launched.

Engine note: for a vls_sam mount, the C++ weapon-release service overrides the fired missile's speed/turn_rate/fuse_distance/damage/max_flight_time_s from the ship record's naval_weapon_system.mounts[] fields, not from this standalone Missile record, per the repo's sm6.json convention. This record is documentation/reference only for VLS-launched HHQ-9B; the ship record's mount fields drive actual in-engine outcomes.
